name: Tweet screenshot meme
summary: A cropped screenshot of a short social post in its own interface: avatar, name, text and a row of counters. The joke lives in the words, and the crop and the interface give it proof and tone.

philosophy.core_thesis: Use the plain look of a social post as a frame, so that the text reads as a real voice.
design_principles: Crop the screenshot to the post card at a width of 550px to 600px with 16px of side padding.
Show an avatar of 48px (circle), a bold name and a grey handle above the text.
Set the post text in a system sans-serif at 15px to 17px with a line height of 1.35.
Keep a row of 4 counters (reply, repost, like, share) in 13px grey type under the text.
Use a white card on light mode or a #15202B card on dim mode; do not mix them.
Add a thin 1px border or leave the edge raw; crop with a few pixels of the next post visible.
Keep the screenshot slightly compressed, as the original; do not sharpen it.
anti_patterns: Fancy fonts in the post text
A cropped avatar with no name
Perfect, uncompressed rendering of a fake card

layout.grid_mechanics: A single column card of 560px width; 16px padding; avatar and text in 2 columns (48px and the rest).
layout.whitespace_ratio: The card is dense: 8% to 15% of the area stays empty; spacing steps are 4, 8, 12 and 16px.
layout.alignment_rules: Left-aligned text with the avatar at the top left; counters align left under the text.
layout.container_geometry: A rectangle with a 0px to 12px radius and a 1px border.

font_pairings.note: Inter stands in for the system sans of the interface.
A second neutral sans for the counters.

hierarchy_rules: Use name in bold (700) at 15px, handle in regular grey.

color.palette_structure: A white or dim card, black or white text, grey for the meta text and one blue.
color.contrast_rules: Text #0F1419 on white gives 18:1; meta grey #536471 on white gives 6:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat card with a 1px light border; no gradient.

materiality.surface_simulation: A phone or desktop interface, captured as a flat screen image.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px border #CFD9DE or none; raw crop edges.

ornamentation_details.iconography: A reply, repost, like and share icon at 18px, outline style.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A circle avatar; sometimes a picture or an emoji in the text.

motion.transition_physics: Static image. A web version types the post text at 40ms per character.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover tints the card background by 4% grey.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels the post is a real, overheard voice and reads the joke straight.

avoid_when: The post imitates a real private person.
The post makes false claims that could mislead.

modifiers.how: Move the text out of the card into outlined capitals on a photo.
Keep the card but pair it with a strange image and a calm, odd line.
Switch to the #15202B dim card with #E7E9EA text and #8B98A5 meta text.

pack.why: A neutral outline family that matches interface counters.

ground.why: Thin rules between cards echo the feed list.

tailwind.classes: rounded-full bg-[#1D9BF0] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-[#0F1419] hover:bg-[#1A8CD8]
